executionStatus: Definitions and examples only; not connected to the current quote runtime

ruleRecordContract.missingEvidence: needsInformation; never assume an eligibility or feasibility check passed
ruleRecordContract.conflictPolicy: Block incompatible requirements or multiple prices at the same priority; do not silently use last write wins
ruleRecordContract.overridePolicy: An offer can narrow a PS range and add requirements. Widening a PS/CFSS constraint requires an approved new compatible version. Hard technical, ownership and regulatory constraints cannot be waived by a discount approval.

rules.name: One root specification
rules.check: A simple sellable offering references exactly one root PS; a bundle-of-offers uses a separate explicit pattern.

rules.name: Valid composition graph
rules.check: Child references resolve to pinned versions and composition contains no self-reference or cycles.

rules.name: Mandatory primary line
rules.check: The configured subscription has exactly one primary Mobile Line; secondary identities use a separate configured limit.

rules.name: Option and characteristic cardinality
rules.check: Selected quantities and characteristic counts meet their min/max/default and choice-group limits.

rules.name: Required capability
rules.check: A selected component's required capability exists in the order or verified inventory; a voice capability does not imply a purchased UK-minutes bundle.

rules.name: Exclusion and recommendation
rules.check: Reject excluded combinations and multiple selections from a single-choice group; recommendations remain suggestions.

rules.name: Sale lifecycle and date window
rules.check: The offer is sellable for the interaction date; expiry and retirement block a new sale without disabling an existing contracted service.

rules.name: Customer and territory eligibility
rules.check: Segment, residency and any age or entitlement evidence meet the selected offer's explicit criteria; no universal age threshold is assumed.

rules.name: Channel and acquisition cohort
rules.check: The selected web/store/partner channel and new/existing/port-in customer cohort qualify.

rules.name: Credit and payment qualification
rules.check: Run credit, arrears or payment checks only where the offer requires them; prepaid and postpaid policies can differ.

rules.name: Existing-product prerequisite
rules.check: A companion benefit or multi-product discount has an eligible active parent product belonging to the correct account.

rules.name: Qualification evidence freshness
rules.check: A missing, pending or expired qualification cannot be treated as qualified; return the reason and a request for evidence.

rules.name: SIM form and device support
rules.check: The requested physical/eSIM path is supported by the device, operator activation channel and current device matrix.

rules.name: Cellular companion support
rules.check: A watch requesting standalone cellular connectivity is a supported cellular model and can be entitled and activated.

rules.name: Platform and OS compatibility
rules.check: Device brand, OS version and primary/companion pairing meet the versioned compatibility matrix.

rules.name: Radio and coverage feasibility
rules.check: The access technology and required coverage are technically available; a maximum speed cap is not represented as a guaranteed speed.

rules.name: Optional feature eligibility
rules.check: Visual voicemail, WiFi Calling and similar feature selections meet plan, device and network prerequisites.

rules.name: Companion messaging support
rules.check: Apply device/service-profile restrictions such as unsupported MMS or voice/SMS on a data-only companion.

rules.name: Commitment and start anchor
rules.check: Choose an allowed commitment and explicit start event, such as activation; calculate its end from the accepted agreement.

rules.name: Independent billing and allowance cycles
rules.check: Keep commitment, billing frequency and allowance validity separate; 30 days does not equal a calendar month.

rules.name: Renewal consent and funds
rules.check: Renew only under the accepted renewal policy and payment conditions; declare the insufficient-funds outcome.

rules.name: Calendar versus anniversary timing
rules.check: Distinguish fixed calendar price events from months-since-activation events and prevent unintended double application.

rules.name: Cancellation and notice
rules.check: Evaluate notice, cancellation rights, contract cohort and permitted remaining-term charges at the effective termination date.

rules.name: End-of-commitment behavior
rules.check: Ending a minimum term follows the agreed rolling, renewal or termination policy and does not automatically disconnect a line.

families.name: Price, tax and future price schedules

rules.name: Typed money and charge
rules.check: Every recurring, one-time or usage charge declares currency, tax basis, unit and rounding; money uses decimal arithmetic.

rules.name: Disclosed consumer price changes
rules.check: Applicable new UK consumer core-subscription schedules state exact GBP amounts and dates; exclude inflation/percentage-based scheduled increases for this cohort.

rules.name: Unambiguous temporal price
rules.check: For a given charge component exactly one applicable price wins; reject gaps, overlaps and unresolved same-priority alternatives.

rules.name: Proration and first/final bill
rules.check: Define whether a mid-cycle change is prorated, the day-count basis, charging anchor and rounding boundary.

rules.name: Deterministic calculation order
rules.check: Apply compatible adjustments, caps and tax in a specified sequence and preserve the calculation breakdown.

rules.name: Fixed-price and contracted cohort
rules.check: A no-scheduled-rise policy has no annual increase; a new catalogue price does not silently replace an existing customer's accepted schedule.

rules.name: Sale and activation deadlines
rules.check: The purchase is within the promotion window and activation meets its separate deadline; a visible expired banner cannot qualify.

rules.name: Redemption and cohort limits
rules.check: Enforce new-customer, channel, port-in, previous-customer and per-number/account redemption limits.

rules.name: Introductory versus ongoing price
rules.check: Record the initial price, number of discounted cycles and ongoing price without treating the introductory amount as permanent.

rules.name: Promotion stacking
rules.check: Only allowed promotion combinations stack; mutually exclusive benefits use an explicit winning rule or customer choice.

rules.name: Qualifying-product discount
rules.check: A multi-line or bundle discount states its qualifying product, duration and outcome when that product is removed.

rules.name: Trial conversion consent
rules.check: A trial that becomes paid declares the end date, future charge, required acceptance and cancellation route.

rules.name: Allowance value and unlimited semantics
rules.check: Declare finite amount or explicit unlimited mode, unit and applicable fair-use policy; never encode unlimited as a large arbitrary number.

rules.name: Allowance reset anchor
rules.check: Reset on the declared billing/activation/30-day boundary; late events cannot grant the cycle twice.

rules.name: Expiry and rollover
rules.check: Each base, add-on, gifted or promotional bucket has its own expiry and rollover policy.

rules.name: Consumption order and rounding
rules.check: Select an eligible bucket by location, traffic class and priority, with explicit usage rounding and minimum units.

rules.name: Exhaustion behavior
rules.check: Exhaustion follows block, throttle, paid overage or top-up policy; buying a top-up and resetting a cycle restore only authorized entitlement.

rules.name: Spend-cap coverage
rules.check: A spend cap declares which usage and charges it includes and excludes; a zero usage cap does not imply all account charges are zero.

rules.name: Domestic destination classification
rules.check: Domestic calling/text rules explicitly include eligible number classes and exclude premium or special destinations as configured.

rules.name: International destination classification
rules.check: International minutes from home are restricted by versioned country, number and mobile/landline lists.

rules.name: Roaming access versus charging
rules.check: Roaming access permission on Mobile Line does not imply free usage; eligible voice/SMS/data rating policies must also resolve.

rules.name: Zone and roaming cap
rules.check: Use the selected plan's zone list and roaming cap; an unlimited domestic bucket does not automatically remove the roaming cap.

rules.name: Roaming fair-use and duration
rules.check: Apply the operator's stable-link, permanent-roaming and usage-window policy, with required evidence and notices.

rules.name: Companion roaming eligibility
rules.check: A companion's roaming eligibility follows the device and selected service profile rather than inheriting every primary-line capability.

rules.name: Account ownership and authority
rules.check: Donor, recipient and sharing-group membership meet account ownership and authorized-user rules.

rules.name: Mode-specific member eligibility
rules.check: Gift, pooled allowance and companion modes use different eligible member classes; an operator may exclude watches from gifting while supporting companion sharing.

rules.name: Transfer amount and limits
rules.check: Gift amount meets quantum/min/max and unreserved donor balance; enforce cycle caps without interpreting unlimited as transferable infinity.

rules.name: Atomic conservation and expiry
rules.check: A gift debits and credits the same units atomically, applies the declared expiry and handles retry/concurrent requests once.

rules.name: Companion identity and number association
rules.check: Companion activation binds its own subscription identity to the correct primary group; number sharing is optional and separate from allowance sharing.

rules.name: Group policy inheritance
rules.check: Declare which bars/entitlements propagate across members, SIM-specific exceptions and maximum member count.

rules.name: Service instance identity and reuse
rules.check: Reuse is scoped by service specification plus line/account/group identity; two PSs do not create duplicate voice or line CFSs, and two different lines are never merged.

rules.name: Characteristic transforms and conflicts
rules.check: Map commercial values into typed service characteristics with explicit units and merge strategies; conflicting permissions or values require resolution.

rules.name: Dependency graph and inventory reuse
rules.check: Order required CFSs before dependants; verified existing services can satisfy dependencies; reject cycles and unresolved references.

rules.name: Commercial-only versus service change
rules.check: A price/commitment-only change does not reprovision the network; an entitlement change amends the existing CFS at the agreed effective time.

rules.name: Technical solution qualification
rules.check: Choose a feasible RFS solution through technical qualification before activation; qualification alone does not allocate a resource.

rules.name: Shared service release
rules.check: Removing one commercial component only removes its owned entitlement; keep a shared CFS while other products or dependants require it.

rules.name: Allowed transitions
rules.check: Add, amend, suspend, resume, migrate and remove follow the offer/service lifecycle and published migration paths.

rules.name: Commitment impact of change
rules.check: Declare whether the change preserves or restarts commitment and whether charges apply; obtain required acceptance.

rules.name: Effective change boundary
rules.check: Upgrades, downgrades and allowance changes use immediate, requested-date or next-cycle timing with explicit unused-balance treatment.

rules.name: Port-in and SIM replacement identity
rules.check: Number porting or SIM replacement preserves the correct subscription/product identity and retires the replaced resource without duplicating the purchase.

rules.name: Parent and member removal
rules.check: Deleting a primary line or qualifying product first resolves companion memberships, dependent services and conditional discounts.

rules.name: Concurrent change and revalidation
rules.check: Revalidate against current inventory before submission, reject stale changes and apply each authorized change once.

rules.name: Approved publication
rules.check: A revision is publishable only with complete mappings, required source evidence, ownership, checks and an approval record.

rules.name: Federated source integrity
rules.check: Imports preserve source identity/version, reject stale updates and unresolved dependencies, and reconcile conflicts before publication.

rules.name: Human commercial exception
rules.check: Discounts and commercial exceptions need an authorized decision; approval cannot waive hard compatibility, ownership or regulatory constraints.

rules.name: Reproducible decision snapshot
rules.check: Pin catalogue/rule/price/zone/device-matrix versions, timestamps and accepted contract terms; never silently reprice a saved accepted contract.

rules.name: Explainability and notification
rules.check: Return rule IDs, reasons, required information and applicable price/renewal/expiry notices without exposing technical service detail to product managers.

rules.name: Deterministic activation of rules
rules.check: Apply the accepted version at its effective event once; support replay, conflict detection and compensation for partial operations; model output cannot override the rules.
